questions.q: Which two principles of design are most commonly used together to make an artwork feel both visually stable and interesting at the same time?
questions.explain: Balance ensures the visual stability of a composition so it doesn't feel 'lop-sided', while Variety ensures the artwork remains interesting to look at by breaking monotony.
